options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: app_replacemsg
options.description: Enable/disable replacement messages for blocked applications. choice | disable | Disable replacement messages for blocked applications. choice | enable | Enable replacement messages for blocked applications.

options.name: comment
options.description: comments

options.name: deep_app_inspection
options.description: Enable/disable deep application inspection. choice | disable | Disable deep application inspection. choice | enable | Enable deep application inspection.

options.name: entries
options.description: EXPERTS ONLY! KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API IS REQUIRED! List of multiple child objects to be added. Expects a list of dictionaries. Dictionaries must use FortiManager API parameters, not the ansible ones listed below. If submitted, all other prefixed sub-parameters ARE IGNORED. This object is MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with its options. We expect that you know what you are doing with these list parameters, and are leveraging the JSON API Guide. WHEN IN DOUBT, OMIT THE USE OF THIS PARAMETER AND USE THE SUB

options.name: entries_action
options.description: Pass or block traffic, or reset connection for traffic from this application. choice | pass | Pass or allow matching traffic. choice | block | Block or drop matching traffic. choice | reset | Reset sessions for matching traffic.

options.name: entries_application
options.description: ID of allowed applications.

options.name: entries_behavior
options.description: Application behavior filter.

options.name: entries_category
options.description: Category ID list.

options.name: entries_log
options.description: Enable/disable logging for this application list. choice | disable | Disable logging. choice | enable | Enable logging.

options.name: entries_log_packet
options.description: Enable/disable packet logging. choice | disable | Disable packet logging. choice | enable | Enable packet logging.

options.name: entries_parameters_value
options.description: Parameter value.

options.name: entries_per_ip_shaper
options.description: Per-IP traffic shaper.

options.name: entries_popularity
options.description: Application popularity filter (1 - 5, from least to most popular). FLAG Based Options. Specify multiple in list form. flag | 1 | Popularity level 1. flag | 2 | Popularity level 2. flag | 3 | Popularity level 3. flag | 4 | Popularity level 4. flag | 5 | Popularity level 5.

options.name: entries_protocols
options.description: Application protocol filter.

options.name: entries_quarantine
options.description: Quarantine method. choice | none | Quarantine is disabled. choice | attacker | Block all traffic sent from attacker's IP address. The attacker's IP address is also added to the banned user list. The target's address is not affected.

options.name: entries_quarantine_expiry
options.description: Duration of quarantine. (Format Requires quarantine set to attacker.

options.name: entries_quarantine_log
options.description: Enable/disable quarantine logging. choice | disable | Disable quarantine logging. choice | enable | Enable quarantine logging.

options.name: entries_rate_count
options.description: Count of the rate.

options.name: entries_rate_duration
options.description: Duration (sec) of the rate.

options.name: entries_rate_mode
options.description: Rate limit mode. choice | periodical | Allow configured number of packets every rate-duration. choice | continuous | Block packets once the rate is reached.

options.name: entries_rate_track
options.description: Track the packet protocol field. choice | none | choice | src-ip | Source IP. choice | dest-ip | Destination IP. choice | dhcp-client-mac | DHCP client. choice | dns-domain | DNS domain.

options.name: entries_risk
options.description: Risk, or impact, of allowing traffic from this application to occur 1 - 5; (Low, Elevated, Medium, High, and Critical).

options.name: entries_session_ttl
options.description: Session TTL (0 = default).

options.name: entries_shaper
options.description: Traffic shaper.

options.name: entries_shaper_reverse
options.description: Reverse traffic shaper.

options.name: entries_sub_category
options.description: Application Sub-category ID list.

options.name: entries_technology
options.description: Application technology filter.

options.name: entries_vendor
options.description: Application vendor filter.

options.name: extended_log
options.description: Enable/disable extended logging. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values

options.name: name
options.description: List name.

options.name: options
options.description: NO DESCRIPTION PARSED ENTER MANUALLY FLAG Based Options. Specify multiple in list form. flag | allow-dns | Allow DNS. flag | allow-icmp | Allow ICMP. flag | allow-http | Allow generic HTTP web browsing. flag | allow-ssl | Allow generic SSL communication. flag | allow-quic | Allow QUIC.

options.name: other_application_action
options.description: Action for other applications. choice | pass | Allow sessions matching an application in this application list. choice | block | Block sessions matching an application in this application list.

options.name: other_application_log
options.description: Enable/disable logging for other applications. choice | disable | Disable logging for other applications. choice | enable | Enable logging for other applications.

options.name: p2p_black_list
options.description: NO DESCRIPTION PARSED ENTER MANUALLY FLAG Based Options. Specify multiple in list form. flag | skype | Skype. flag | edonkey | Edonkey. flag | bittorrent | Bit torrent.

options.name: replacemsg_group
options.description: Replacement message group.

options.name: unknown_application_action
options.description: Pass or block traffic from unknown applications. choice | pass | Pass or allow unknown applications. choice | block | Drop or block unknown applications.

options.name: unknown_application_log
options.description: Enable/disable logging for unknown applications. choice | disable | Disable logging for unknown applications. choice | enable | Enable logging for unknown applications.
